description: Implementation of MediaBufferGroup class managing media buffers with shared memory support, including buffer allocation, deallocation, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: MediaBufferGroup
classes.description: Class managing a group of media buffers with thread-safe allocation and deallocation, supporting shared memory buffers.

classes.name: MediaBufferGroup::InternalData
classes.description: Internal data structure holding synchronization primitives and buffer list for MediaBufferGroup.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::MediaBufferGroup
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer group with a growth limit.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::MediaBufferGroup
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer group with specified number of buffers, buffer size, and growth limit.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::init
methods.description: Initializes the buffer group with specified number of buffers, buffer size, and growth limit, handling shared and non-shared memory allocation.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::~MediaBufferGroup
methods.description: Destructor releasing all buffers and cleaning up internal data.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::add_buffer
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the group, releasing excess buffers if above growth limit.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::has_buffers
methods.description: Checks if the group has available buffers or can allocate more.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::acquire_buffer
methods.description: Allocates or reuses a buffer of requested size, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::buffers
methods.description: Returns the current number of buffers in the group.

methods.name: MediaBufferGroup::signalBufferReturned
methods.description: Signals that a buffer has been returned to the group, waking up waiting threads.
